title: Size of the Overpayment against the Claim Payment Run — Network Participation Agreements
content:
This rule applies when Cascade continues recovering an overpayment from a claim payment run of an agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** that is paid by claim payments rather than capitation. A large overpayment, measured against the run it is withheld from, raises the share withheld.

**Clause.** The run notice-size adjustment to the continuing run withholding share is set by the notice amount of the overpayment under recovery, measured against the run's claim payment amount:

- a notice amount of at least the run's claim payment amount adds 8 share points;
- a notice amount of at least 0.4 times (40 percent of) that amount, but less than it, adds 5 share points;
- a smaller notice amount adds nothing.

## Terms

- **Overpayment under recovery.** The overpayment that the agreement's most recent withholding was applied to.
- **Notice amount.** The amount on its notice, as issued.
- **The run.** The agreement's most recent claim payment remittance. Its claim payment amount is the amount paid in that remittance.
- **Ties.** Where two ledger entries share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's ledger is taken.

## Worked judgements (hypothetical)

| Run's claim payment amount | Notice amount | Share points added |
|---|---|---|
| 5000.00 USD | 1999.99 USD | None |
| 5000.00 USD | 2000.00 USD | 5 |
| 5000.00 USD | 4999.99 USD | 5 |
| 5000.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 8 |
